raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?m
  where all
    match
      relation "be open"
      role subject ?m
      role object "the Cluj Court of Appeal"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have a hearing"
      role subject ?m
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  during "October"
  except ?m "the Patrascu ones"
